name: DigitalM InsideSEO
author: insideseo

sections.description:
DigitalM InsideSEO shows you the truth about your site, not a flattering “SEO score 85/100” but concrete facts and real errors.

InsideSEO shows you concrete problems in plain language: “84 people could not pay because your checkout is broken, here is why and how to fix it”.

Who it is for

  • WooCommerce stores that get traffic but not enough sales
  • Service businesses that want to measure calls, emails and form submissions
  • Blogs that want to know which content brings real results

What the plugin includes

Mirror, what search engines see:

  • Technical checks (speed, indexing, robots, sitemap)
  • Structured data (schema), which types you have and which are missing
  • Access for AI bots (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini)
  • Meta descriptions, titles and H1, detects missing and problematic ones

Error audit:

  • 50+ automatic checks on every page
  • Hidden Cyrillic in SEO fields, invisible characters that quietly break search
  • Broken links and orphaned pages

Sales and conversions:

  • Orders by channel (Google, Facebook, direct)
  • Revenue and ROAS (with an ad spend file)
  • Goals for service sites: calls, emails, forms

Crawl:

  • Detection of broken links and orphaned pages
  • Full crawl of your own site, run on demand

Positioning:

  • Keyword rankings (from Google Search Console)
  • Won and lost positions, queries close to the top 10

Highlights

  • A mirror, not a lie, we show the facts, we do not sugar-coat them
  • See why you do not sell, sales by channel plus checkout diagnostics
  • AI readiness, checks for ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity visibility
  • GDPR friendly, your data stays on your own site, it does not go to a foreign cloud
  • Works alongside your SEO plugin, it reads the fields of Yoast, RankMath and others instead of replacing them

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or newer
  • PHP 8.1 or newer
  • WooCommerce (optional, for sales data)
  • Google Search Console and GA4 accounts for full data

External Services

DigitalM InsideSEO may communicate with the following external services when you use specific features.

seo.digitalmseo.com (our service)

  • What: the Google connection uses our service as a connection helper, so you do not have to create your own Google Cloud project.
  • When: only when you click “Connect Google account”.
  • What is sent: your site URL, plugin version, and a public verification key. Google tokens are stored only on your own site; our service never stores them.
  • Privacy Policy: https://seo.digitalmseo.com/en/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Use: https://seo.digitalmseo.com/en/terms/

Google APIs (optional)

  • What: Search Console API and GA4 API.
  • When: when the user connects their accounts.
  • What is sent: OAuth tokens and data requests.
  • Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

AI provider APIs (optional)

  • What: AI suggestions for questions (FAQ) and schema on the GEO/AEO screen.
  • When: only when the user explicitly clicks a “Suggest” button, using the AI provider configured in WordPress (WordPress 7.0 Connectors) or the user’s own API key.
  • What is sent: page context (title, content excerpt).
  • The user pays their AI provider directly; we never see or store the key on our servers.

Credits

Built by Digital M SEO Ltd (digitalmseo.com).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Follow the setup wizard, or open Settings and connect Google Search Console and GA4.
  4. Run the first audit from the SEO tab.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. Everything in this plugin works forever with no time limit.

What data do you collect and where do you store it?

The plugin collects data about the SEO health of your site (titles, meta descriptions, speed, rankings). This data is stored on your own WordPress site, not on our server.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, RankMath, SEOPress or All in One SEO?

Yes. InsideSEO is built to work alongside them, not to replace them. It reads the meta data from the active SEO plugin and adds deeper analysis.

Does it support multilingual sites?

Yes. It runs hreflang checks automatically when it detects a multilingual setup.

Will the plugin slow down my site?

No. InsideSEO is built on the principle of minimal work on your site. Scans run in small batches and never block a page load.

Do I need Google Search Console and GA4?

Not strictly, but we strongly recommend them. Without them you will not see rankings, impressions, CTR and traffic data, only the technical checks.

Do you support AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity)?

Yes. InsideSEO has an AI readiness section that checks whether AI bots can reach your site, whether you have structured data they understand, and whether your content is ready to be quoted.
sections.changelog:
0.213.5

  • Removed all remaining paid/locked wording from the English translations and the readme.
  • The site now registers with our connection service only when the user clicks “Connect Google account” (no automatic call before consent).

0.213.2

  • The Google connection origin check now runs entirely inside the plugin, with no dependency on the hub database.

0.213.1

  • Fixed the admin stylesheet not loading after the slug change.

0.213.0

  • The “Fix” button now writes titles and meta descriptions directly into the active SEO plugin (Yoast, RankMath, SEOPress, All in One SEO) for everyone, with no restrictions.
  • Text domain aligned with the plugin slug (digitalm-insideseo).
  • Hardened the Google account connection with an origin check on the return step.

0.212.0

  • Renamed to DigitalM InsideSEO.
  • Streamlined the plugin for the WordPress.org directory.
  • Menu reorganized: Mirror, Conversions, Rankings, SEO, GEO/AEO, Settings, System info, About.

0.211.0

  • Google connection simplified to a single button.
  • Full English translation of the interface.
  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0 AI Connectors (with graceful fallback for WordPress 6.2+).

0.210.0

  • Fixed input sanitization and output escaping across admin screens.
  • Added translator comments for all strings with placeholders.
